item.title: Quentin Tarantino Initially Wanted Tim Roth, Johnny Depp, & Simon Pegg For Michael Fassbender’s Role In ‘Inglourious Basterds’
item.description: Quentin Tarantino ’s films are full of fascinating casting what-ifs, from actors who nearly landed iconic roles to stars who slipped through his fingers. And given the filmmaker’s famously specific tastes, there’s usually an interesting story behind each one. Take “ Inglourious Basterds ,” for example. Michael Fassbender ’s memorable turn as British Lieutenant Archie Hicox seems like inspired casting in retrospect, but Tarantino originally had three very different actors in mind: at one point, Tim Roth , Johnny Depp , and then Simon Pegg .
